classification: The hosted run passed release provenance, package/browser setup, Chromium startup, and measured readiness. In the first guest Chat turn, a trusted native Send click reached and bubbled through the panel, but no user message appeared and no chat POST was observed. The driver stopped before any assistant reply, follow-up, or post-reload conversation. This is zero product acceptance credit; the evidence localizes failure to the UI submit boundary before transport.

first_failure.expected: A trusted Send click submits the committed composer draft, creates a user message, and emits a guest chat POST that reaches a terminal assistant reply.
first_failure.native_click_implementation: The driver selected the unique button[aria-label=Send message] inside the active Chat tabpanel, required a stable hit-tested point within visible clipped bounds, then sent CDP Input.dispatchMouseEvent mousePressed and mouseReleased. It did not call DOM click(). The probe observed one trusted click and one bubble click at the React root.

resource_interpretation: Package and browser journals have valid finals. Guest admission and periodic resource watch stayed healthy with no invalidating resource reason, but the child exited 1 and the guest journal decision is child_failed, not valid; therefore no valid guest resource final or product verdict is claimed.
product_verdict: unverified; first Send click produced no user message, no guest chat POST, and no assistant terminal reply
next_action: Diagnose the UI submit-to-user-message boundary using the native click probe and sanitized artifact. Require independent review of any source fix, then perform a fresh guarded B run on an eligible immutable release; do not repeat this artifact or infer product acceptance.
